shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat package-lock.json 2>/dev/null | head -40; git log --stat | head -40; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs && echo ---- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n 1,80p components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; echo ---SELECT; sed -n 1,120p components/Select/types.d.ts | grep -nE "options|onUpdate|value|width|placeholder|label|size|filterable" | head -30; echo ---SWITCH; cat components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; sed -n 1,60p components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ---CHECKBOX-ctrl; grep -nE "checked|onUpdate|content|title" components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts components/types.d.ts | head; echo ---AVATAR; grep -nE "imgUrl|text|size|theme|view|fallbackImgUrl" components/Avatar/types.d.ts | head -20; echo ---FLEX; grep -nE "direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo ---TOASTER; ls components/Toaster; echo ---TEXT; grep -nE "variant|color" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -5; echo ---BUTTON; grep -nE "view|size|loading|disabled|width" components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; echo ---CARD; grep -nE "view|type|theme|size" components/Card/Card.d.ts | head

ls components/Avatar; grep -nE "imgUrl|text|size|theme|view|fallbackImgUrl|alt" components/Avatar/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---TOASTER; sed -n 1,40p components/Toaster/types.d.ts; grep -n "useToaster" components/Toaster/hooks/*.d.ts components/Toaster/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "ToasterProvider\|ToasterComponent" components/Toaster/index.d.ts; echo ---SELECT-OPT; sed -n 100,135p components/Select/types.d.ts; echo ---LAYOUT; ls components/layout; echo ---TEXT-VARIANTS; grep -nE "TextVariant|TEXT_VARIANTS" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -3; grep -nE "'[a-z]+-[0-9]'" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -3; echo ---ICONS; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; echo ---FilePreview; grep -nE "file|onClick|actions|view" components/FilePreview/FilePreview.d.ts | head

cat components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,30p components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ---ICONS; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head; grep -n '"version"' /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -iE "^(ArrowUpFromLine|Camera|TrashBin|Xmark|Picture|Globe|Clock|ShieldCheck|Envelope|Person|Bell)\.(js|d\.ts)$"; echo ---TOASTER-DEFAULT; grep -n "toaster\|Toaster" components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; echo ---DIVIDER; grep -n "orientation\|children" components/Divider/Divider.d.ts | head -3; echo ---SPACE; grep -n "Space" components/layout/types.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n "ButtonView =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts; grep -nE "data|size" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "export declare class Toaster\|export { Toaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts | head; grep -n "AvatarSize =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; grep -rn '"@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json | head -3; node -v; (timeout 60 npm install --save "@gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.0" --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -5); grep -n "icons" package.json
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome chrome headless_shell 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer"; ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer"; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*chrom*" -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v proc | head) ; echo "---done"
cd /tmp && mkdir -p pw && cd pw && (timeout 100 npx -y playwright@1.49.1 install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "exit=$?") ; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cd /tmp/pw && npx -y playwright@1.49.1 install chromium > /tmp/pw/install.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?" >> /tmp/pw/install.log

cp /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mts ./__vitest.smoke.config.mts && cp /tmp/ssr-smoke.test.tsx src/__ssr_smoke.test.tsx && npx vitest run --config ./__vitest.smoke.config.mts 2>&1 | tail -25; rm -f src/__ssr_smoke.test.tsx ./__vitest.smoke.config.mts; git status --short
rm -rf dist && tail -c 400 /tmp/pw/install.log; echo; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 110 npm i playwright@1.49.1 --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -2; ls node_modules/playwright >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo PW_OK; tail -c 120 /tmp/pw/install.log
tail -c 300 /tmp/pw/install.log | tr -d '\r' | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright; cd /tmp/pw && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "--- console:"; cat /tmp/pw/errors.txt; ls -la /tmp/pw/*.png
id; which apt-get sudo; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; cat /etc/os-release | head -2
cd ~/.cache/ms-playwright && BIN=$(find chromium_headless_shell-1148 -name "headless_shell" -type f | head -1); echo "$BIN"; ldd "$BIN" | grep "not found" | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u

mkdir -p /tmp/apt/state/lists/partial /tmp/apt/cache/archives/partial /tmp/apt/root /tmp/apt/debs && cd /tmp/apt/debs && APT="apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp/apt/state -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/apt/cache -o Debug::NoLocking=1" && timeout 90 $APT update 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 100 $APT download libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libasound2 libatk1.0-0 libatspi2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libdrm2 libgbm1 libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libxkbcommon0 2>&1 | tail -3; ls *.deb 2>/dev/null | wc -l

cd /tmp/apt/debs && for d in *.deb; do dpkg -x "$d" /tmp/apt/root; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; BIN=~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1148/chrome-linux/headless_shell; ldd "$BIN" | grep "not found" | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u; echo "--- deps of extracted libs:"; for f in /tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*.so*; do ldd "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep "not found" | awk '{print $1}'; done | sort -u

cd /tmp/apt/debs && APT="apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp/apt/state -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/apt/cache -o Debug::NoLocking=1" && timeout 100 $APT download libxi6 libxrender1 libwayland-server0 libsqlite3-0 2>&1 | tail -1 && for d in libxi6*.deb libxrender1*.deb libwayland-server0*.deb libsqlite3-0*.deb; do dpkg -x "$d" /tmp/apt/root; done; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu; BIN=~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1148/chrome-linux/headless_shell; echo "still missing:"; ldd "$BIN" | grep "not found" | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u; cd /tmp/pw && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "--- console:"; cat /tmp/pw/errors.txt 2>/dev/null; ls /tmp/pw/*.png 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s|const browser = await chromium.launch();|const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage', '--disable-gpu', '--disable-setuid-sandbox'] });|" shot.mjs && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu && DEBUG=pw:browser node shot.mjs 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\s*$" | tail -25; echo "--- console:"; cat /tmp/pw/errors.txt 2>/dev/null; ls /tmp/pw/*.png 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/apt/debs && APT="apt-get -o Dir::State=/tmp/apt/state -o Dir::Cache=/tmp/apt/cache -o Debug::NoLocking=1" && timeout 100 $APT download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core 2>&1 | tail -1 && for d in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg -x "$d" /tmp/apt/root; done; ls /tmp/apt/root/etc/fonts/fonts.conf /tmp/apt/root/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu | head -3
cd /tmp/pw && sed -i "s|args: \['--no-sandbox'|args: [...(process.env.EXTRA_ARGS ? process.env.EXTRA_ARGS.split(' ') : []), '--no-sandbox'|" shot.mjs && grep -n "chromium.launch" shot.mjs
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_SYSROOT=/tmp/apt/root
if node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; then echo RUN1_DONE; fi
ls /tmp/pw/*.png 2>/dev/null || { echo "--- retry single-process"; EXTRA_ARGS="--single-process --no-zygote" node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; ls /tmp/pw/*.png 2>/dev/null; }
echo "--- console:"; cat /tmp/pw/errors.txt 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/pw && sed -n 25p shot.mjs && sed -i "s|await page.getByRole('switch').click();|await page.getByText('Выключена').click();|" shot.mjs && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/apt/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/apt/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu FONTCONFIG_SYSROOT=/tmp/apt/root && rm -f /tmp/pw/0*.png && node shot.mjs 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "--- console:"; cat /tmp/pw/errors.txt 2>/dev/null; ls /tmp/pw/*.png 2>/dev/null

pkill -f "vite --port 5173" ; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|✓ built" ; npx vitest run 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests|FAIL"; rm -rf dist; git status --short; echo ---; git diff package.json; find src -type f | sort; wc -l src/profile-settings/*.ts* src/App.tsx | tail -1
kill $(ps aux | grep "[v]ite --port 5173" | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null; ps aux | grep -c "[v]ite --port"

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < "$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite --port 5173"; then kill "${p#/proc/}" && echo "killed ${p#/proc/}"; fi; done; sleep 1; (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5173) 2>/dev/null && echo "still listening" || echo "server stopped"
(echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5173) 2>/dev/null && echo "still listening" || echo "server stopped"
